videos.title: 3 Strategies for Seated Guard Vs. Standing in BJJ: Get Grips and ATTACK (No Gi BJJ)
videos.whyUseful: Teaches three core strategies for seated guard retention against a standing opponent: grip fighting, pummeling for inside position, and attacking entries.

videos.title: Seated Guard Is Easy Once You Understand This
videos.whyUseful: Simplifies seated guard retention by focusing on the key concept of keeping your knees between you and your opponent, with clear positional examples.
